productInvariant: Reusable Salesforce change assurance; the first source application is evidence, not runtime business logic.

capabilities.genericity: Version and required capabilities are configuration, not application constants.
Operates on canonical typed nodes and relations without source vocabulary in core policy; direction-aware propagation, complete ordered path receipts and a separate risk policy remain A2.
Uses source-neutral canonical relations and endpoint roles with explicit direction, depth, evidence-state and path-receipt policies; runtime workflow integration remains pending.

Treats project-, snapshot-, ontology- and profile-bound normalized evidence as the authority substrate; missing record envelopes remain unverified while durable graph ports and complete path replay remain planned.

Compiles and replays source-neutral canonical-edge artifact envelopes against externally pinned project/snapshot, raw and normalized graph, ontology/profile, parser registry/implementation, policy, evidence-state and freshness roots. Release-only gaps are isolated from analysis, all results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY with upstream capture unattested, and no receipt can authorize release.

Deterministically normalizes the current source vocabulary into versioned canonical classes and preserves mapping/trust gaps. Completion requires upstream record envelopes and proof that trusted first-source behavior is preserved; propagation/risk remain separate A2 policy.

Compiles an analysis-only, project/snapshot-isolated context pack from replay-validated canonical structure under deterministic atomic count/character/byte budgets. Caller-supplied source fragments and semantic receipts remain non-authoritative candidates; governed resolution, seed-rationale receipts, provider token/time budgets, outcome memory and workflow consumption remain planned.

Deterministically fuses request-, context-, channel- and freshness-bound exact, lexical, confirmed-graph and semantic candidate receipts under an independently pinned policy/evaluation contract. Outputs remain analysis-only candidates; protected deterministic tiers, conflicts, omissions, outages and upstream context gaps are explicit. Completion requires real channel adapters, trusted A3 verification receipts and an adjudicated hybrid-quality corpus.

Provides a provider-neutral proposal/verifier plus a separately typed replay-validating workflow consumer. The consumer binds the complete change request and graph identity, replays current governance, isolates specialist failures, and can only emit bounded analysis-only candidate/inferred advisory results. Completion requires a real structured-output provider adapter with hard cancellation, independently persisted capture/consumption receipts, retry-safe workflow/checkpoint integration and an adjudicated quality corpus.
Provider-neutral embeddings and standard cosine ranking.
Project- and snapshot-isolated persistent semantic index behind the existing retrieval port; PostgreSQL remains authoritative relational memory.

Typed deterministic stages share governed state, and an isolated policy-configured consumer deterministically merges multiple replay-verified specialist artifacts without mutating authoritative run state. Durable live-provider invocation, capture registry, checkpoint/CAS integration and event outbox remain planned.
Emits bounded typed stage events and deliverables using capability, evidence, artifact, policy and gap identifiers without persisting prompts, secrets or hidden reasoning.

Projects the typed assurance-run contract without scenario literals or client-side governance rules. It separates source-confirmed, human-recorded, inferred, contradictory and unresolved evidence; selected validations from execution receipts; proposals from applied actions; recorded activity from live dependency availability; and current decisions from audit-only history. Ordered path receipts, A6 advisory payloads, persistence health, runtime response validation and automated accessibility auditing remain planned.
Selects graph-connected test kinds rather than named test cases.
Uses metadata identity, accessibility semantics and ambiguity abstention.
Validates evidence identifiers independently of business domain.
Deterministic policy consumes typed risk and validation state, but a non-bypassable evidence-model interlock currently limits every release posture to INCOMPLETE.

Currently provides a versioned policy-validated non-bypassable INCOMPLETE interlock and revalidates persisted decisions on service/API reads without rewriting audit history; full authority requires explicit edge/path provenance, immutable release-input binding, verified builds/obligations, scoped human approvals and deterministic conflicts.
Defines executable run-level metric populations, thresholds, applicability and typed guardrail outcomes without treating heuristic scores as calibrated probability.

Target primary non-vector memory. Run documents and checkpoints are wired, and outcome candidates have an append-only replay-validating adapter foundation. Live PostgreSQL outcome transactions/concurrency plus evidence/chunk, graph, audit, approval and evaluation application ports remain.

Run storage falls back from PostgreSQL to auto-created SQLite/process memory; outcome storage independently falls back through auto-created SQLite, immutable JSON and process cache. Health exposes each active mode and never falls through on corruption, replay, schema, idempotency or ambiguous-write failures.

Retains replay-validated, append-only and explicitly non-authorizing trusted-test, typed incident and unverified human-correction candidates linked to exact run/project/source and policy roots. Completion requires live PostgreSQL verification, HTTP/MCP exposure, signed/tamper-evident anchoring, historical-policy replay, decision/override/production kinds, prior-outcome retrieval integration and an adjudicated corpus.
Tools delegate to shared services and expose no scenario-specific endpoint.

Planned live reads require validated contract routes, field/route allowlists, production-org refusal and redacted audit events; the current CLI adapter only proves bounded inspection and route validation.
Execution consumes selected obligations and configured runners.
Typed worker accepts a generic intent and ephemeral session handoff.
